app.title: give-me-real-gpu settings
app.subtitle: GPU cloud emulator settings
lang.label: Language
status.setup_body: The fake OpenStack API answers 503 until the advertise host and the OpenStack password are set.
status.register_help: Register these values in the management platform.
status.dry_run_title: Dry run is on in General: metrics are generated but not sent.
general.title: General
general.advertise_host_hint: Host name or IP the management platform uses to reach this emulator. It goes into the endpoint URLs of the keystone catalog.
general.secret_set_hint: A password is set. Leave the field empty to keep it.
general.secret_unset_hint: No password yet. The management platform logs in with this password.
general.token_ttl_hint: How long a keystone token stays valid, e.g. 1h or 30m.
general.interval_hint: How often metrics are written to every sink, e.g. 10s. At least 1s.
general.seed_hint: Random seed for the generated values. The same seed gives the same series.
general.seed_invalid: Seed must be a whole number.
general.xid_rate_hint: Chance per GPU per write that an XID error appears, from 0 to 1.
general.xid_rate_invalid: XID error rate must be a number.
general.dry_run_hint: Generate metrics but do not send them to any sink.
general.ports_note: The ports (-listen for the OpenStack API, -ui-listen for this page) are command-line flags. Changing them needs a restart.
general.saved: Saved. The new settings are in effect now.
sinks.title: Sinks
sinks.help: Every enabled sink receives the metrics on each write interval.
sinks.empty: No sinks yet. Add one to start writing metrics.
sinks.name: Name
sinks.url_hint_influxdb_v1: Base URL of the InfluxDB v1 server, e.g. http://192.0.2.20:8086.
sinks.url_hint_influxdb_v2: Base URL of the InfluxDB v2 server, e.g. http://192.0.2.20:8086.
sinks.url_hint_influxdb_v3: Base URL of the InfluxDB 3 server, e.g. http://192.0.2.20:8181.
sinks.url_changed_warning: Changing the URL clears the saved password and token. Enter them again.
sinks.basic_auth_hint: Basic authentication. Leave both empty for none.
sinks.token_hint_v2: API token with write access to the bucket.
sinks.token_hint_v3: Optional. Leave empty when the server runs without authentication.
sinks.credential_id_hint: UUID written as the credential_id tag. Required when the sink is enabled.
sinks.delete_confirm: Delete the sink {name}? Metrics stop going there.
sinks.rules_hint_influxdb: Changes to the tags already sent run first, top to bottom, then the fixed tags are added. Only tag keys change; fields and measurement names stay as they are. Empty rows are ignored.
sinks.rules_hint_otlp: Changes to the labels already sent run first, top to bottom, then the fixed labels are added. Only labels (data point and resource attributes) change; metric names stay as they are. Empty rows are ignored.
sinks.rules_warning: Renaming or dropping a key can break queries on the monitoring server that read this data.
sinks.add_hint_influxdb: Every line gets these key=value tags. When the key is already sent, its value is replaced.
sinks.add_hint_otlp: Every data point gets these key=value labels. When the key is already sent, its value is replaced, on resources too.
sinks.keys_hint_influxdb: Tags this sink sends now, the most common first. Click one to rename or drop it; hover for an example value.
sinks.keys_hint_otlp: Labels this sink sends now, the most common first. Click one to rename or drop it; hover for an example value.
sinks.keys_error: Could not load the keys. You can still type a key below.
sinks.key_added: Added by a fixed tag above
sinks.rule_key_title: Click or start typing to see the keys this sink sends now.
sinks.rule_same_key: New key must differ from the key.
